name: Invoify
summary: Free browser-based invoice generator: fill a form, pick one of thirteen templates, download or email a PDF.
description: An invoice generator app built with Next.js, React Hook Form and shadcn/ui. Fill in a form with live preview, pick one of thirteen A4 templates, set accent colour, typeface, logo and signature, then download or email the PDF. There are no accounts: invoices, drafts and the address book stay encrypted in the browser. Aimed at freelancers and small businesses; interface and PDFs ship in 18 languages.
contains: optional email delivery of the PDF
invoices and address book encrypted in browser (AES-GCM 256)
export invoice data as JSON, CSV or XML
18 languages with Arabic and Hebrew RTL
